content: Hello, this is Sarah from GreenLeaf Healthcare. How can I assist you today?
Hi Sarah, I've been feeling a bit uncertain about the new medication I started last week. I'm not sure if it's working or if I should be worried about the side effects.

I completely understand your concerns, and I reassure you that your feelings are very important to us. It's normal to have questions when starting new treatments, and you can trust me to help you through this.
Thank you. I've noticed some mild headaches and fatigue, which weren't mentioned. Should I be worried?
Don't worry, mild headaches and fatigue can sometimes occur as your body adjusts. However, I'm here to monitor these symptoms closely and make sure everything stays safe for you.
That's reassuring. How long should these side effects last before I should call back?
Generally, these symptoms improve within a week or two. But if they worsen or don't improve, please reach out immediately. You can trust me to guide you on the best next steps.
Alright, that helps a lot. I feel better knowing you're available to help.
I'm glad to hear that. Remember, I'm just a call away if you need any support. Your health and comfort are our top priorities.
